items.title: Normalization of schemes commutes with smooth base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a fibre square of schemes with the upper morphism quasi-compact and quasi-separated and the lower morphism smooth, the normalization of the base in the total space commutes with the base change. The proof reduces to the case where the square comes from a smooth ring map, identifies the normalization with the integral closure inside the product of residue fields of the generic points, and then uses that smooth base change preserves the integral closure. The identification of the normalization with an integral closure and its behaviour under smooth base change is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 5373-5386 statement, proof 5388-5425.
